title: The isomorphism locus in an affine finite free frame is principal
statement: Let W be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let M,N be sheaves of modules on W [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let φ:M→N. Let U be an affine open [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Suppose I,J are finite sets and the ordinary restrictions of M,N to U are isomorphic to the free structure modules indexed by I,J. Then there exists f∈Γ(U,𝒪_W) such that U∩U_φ=D_U(f), where U_φ is the neighbourhood-defined locally invertible open [def-sc-module-map-iso-locus]. No equality of the two ranks is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 10.79.4(3), local matrix argument; Tag 0BDP final determinant sentence

proof.text: Choose Fintype structures on I and J. When their cardinalities agree, Fintype.equivOfCardEq and freeFunctor.mapIso reindex the target frame to I. Let psi be eM.inv followed by the restricted map followed by the reindexed eN.hom. Define delta as det(freeMatrix psi) over the global sections of the open subscheme U, and f as U.topIso.hom(delta). This constructs the witness without any unproved existence theorem.

On V = U.basicOpen(delta), the section delta restricts to a unit, by Scheme.isUnit_ι_appTop_basicOpen. Naturality of restrictFunctorIsoPullback and freeMatrix_pullback identifies the restricted free matrix with freeMatrix psi mapped by V.ι.appTop; RingHom.map_det identifies its determinant with the restricted delta. Apply local_invertible_minor_block_isIso to obtain an inverse map. The canonical frames and restrictFunctorComp transport this to invertibility of the original map restricted along V.ι followed by U.ι.

Use uniqueness of left adjoints to pushforward to compare tensor pullback and Mathlib pullback. For an open immersion g with invertible pullback, g.isoOpensRange and pullbackComp transfer invertibility to pullback along its image-open inclusion. The defining neighbourhood criterion places every g(x) in moduleMapIsoLocus. Scheme.Opens.ι_image_basicOpen_topIso_inv identifies the image of V with W.basicOpen(f), proving the forward inclusion.

For x in U intersect moduleMapIsoLocus, let y be x as a point of U and g:Spec κ(y)→U its residue-field point. The composite g followed by U.ι has singleton image x. Apply isIso_tensorPullback_of_range_subset_moduleMapIsoLocus and the pullback comparison, then pullbackComp and the given frames, to obtain an invertible pullback of psi. For a square free map, the global-section map is surjective; freeSectionsEquiv_app identifies it with multiplication by freeMatrix. Matrix.mulVec_surjective_iff_isUnit and Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det show its determinant is a unit. The freeMatrix_pullback identity and RingHom.map_det identify this with g.appTop(delta). The global sections of Spec κ(y) form a field, so this unit is nonzero. Hom.appTop_ne_zero_iff_mem_basicOpen, fromSpecResidueField_apply and the image-basic-open identity yield x in W.basicOpen(f). The two inclusions give the required equality.

If card I differs from card J, take f=0. A point x of U intersect the locus would give an invertible residue-field pullback by the same preceding argument. Apply global sections and freeSectionsEquiv to its two pulled-back free frames. The induced linear equivalence between the function spaces indexed by I and J over Γ(Spec κ(y),top) forces card I=card J by LinearEquiv.finrank_eq and finite-dimensional function-space finrank, a contradiction. Thus the intersection is empty, as is W.basicOpen(0). Empty U and rank zero are allowed throughout; no affineness, reducedness or positive-rank argument is used.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 10.79.4(3), local free matrix and residue-field criterion; Tag 0BDP, final determinant sentence. J3 formalization uses the proved square free sheaf inverse lemma and pullback-preserves-locus theorem; it replaces the planned stalk converse by the residue-field converse.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleMapIsoLocus_inter_eq_basicOpen_of_free {W : Scheme.{u}}
    {M N : W.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) (U : W.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    {I J : Type u} [Finite I] [Finite J]
    (eM : M.restrict U.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.free I)
    (eN : N.restrict U.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.free J) :
    ∃ f : W.presheaf.obj (.op U),
      (U : Set W) ∩ (moduleMapIsoLocus φ : Set W) = (W.basicOpen f : Set W)
